integrity: An all-parameter proof and reproducible standard-library finite tests are included. Mathematical independence and historical priority have not been externally validated.
scientific_limitations: Finite loopless simple undirected graphs with degree at most d, m>=1. No connectedness requirement. Open rather than closed neighborhoods. No uniqueness outside exact binomial thresholds and no historical priority certification.
title: Sharp binomial-layer law for degree-bounded open-adjacency types
